programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc:
Pascal Brodnicki likes to explore the world through his sense of taste.He loves to prepare various dishes at street stalls, in African villages or on the beach. However, during his culinary journeys it was not always easy for him.Sometimes elephants stole his ingredients.Of course, Pascal couldn't deny himself the pleasure of tasting local delicacies.In Delhi, he stopped for a long time at a paratha stand, in a Zanzibar village he ate rice with coconut, and in Namibia he tried a zebra steak."Taste the world with Pascal" is not only about cooking.The host visited an elephant orphanage in Sri Lanka, fed cheetahs in Africa and climbed a coconut tree.In Bombay he became a teacher and taught Polish to children, and on the coast of Zanzibar he hunted octopus.Everywhere his passion and positive energy attracted crowds of onlookers
This time Pascal went to Namibia, famous for its cow breeding and delicious beef.The chef grills his favorite steaks here and, as usual, he will do it in an unusual place.This time on the farm where they are kept.tamed cheetahs.After meeting the big cats, Pascal sets off north of the country, to Opuwo, where he goes to a supermarket.Here he meets half-naked women from the Himba tribe who are shopping.He also visits the market where he buys a gift for the Herrero tribe - a goat.His gesture wins great acclaim and Pascal is welcomed into the village with an amazing dance.

The next stop on the "Taste the World with Pascal" map is India.Pascal will visit Delhi, where he will taste parathas, traditional wheat pancakes, served with green peas, carrots, bananas or cheese at street stalls.At one of the stalls, Pascal will serve passers-by chicken "Indian style" according to his own recipe.The leader will also visit temples where volunteers prepare free meals for pilgrims.In such kitchens, people cook for up to a thousand people.The cook had never cooked on such a scale.Later, Pascal will go to Bombay, where he will look for the perfect fish for his recipe at the fish market.And then he will prepare it in curry sauce, with peppers and coconut milk.A saleswoman at the local market lends him the kitchen.

The next stage of the African journey is Zanzibar, a beautiful and multicultural island in the Indian Ocean.The local cuisine is a mix of many flavors from around the world.Pascal will go to the Forodhani market, famous for its delicious skewers with colorful stalls.He will discover the secrets of the plantain, also called "elephant's trunk", i.e. a sweet banana, which on the island is treated not as a fruit, but as a vegetable.Pascal will go octopus fishing.Zanzibar is also known for its colorful reefs, white sand, schools of rainbow fish and beautiful coastline.Pascal will set up his kitchen on one of such paradise beaches.This time, he will use a piece of a wooden boat as a countertop, and a natural rock depression filled with sea water as a sink.The chef will use local specialties and prepare seafood in spice sauce.He will invite a group of local women to his feast, who will return the favor with a dinner in a nearby village.

programs.title: Africa Express
programs.desc:
For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship
Participants go to Vibanda Village, where an unusual challenge awaits them: "7 Monsters", i.e. a roulette of flavors.Each pair spins the wheel three times and must eat the selected local dishes until the end.Then the competition moves to the Kenya Railway Museum, where you have to arrange ten photos from different stages of the race.Another obstacle is field assignments in Nairobi.Participants go to designated places where they solve numerical puzzles that require perceptiveness and reflexes.In the finale, the couples travel through various corners of the city, visiting, among others:a hairdressing salon or a giraffe shelter.Only the fastest and most persistent have a chance to reach the finish line, located on the roof of the Kenya International Convention Center.

programs.title: Travel patent
programs.desc: Artur Kot goes to the wildest part of Cambodia, where in the heart of the jungle there is the Elephant Valley center, where volunteers from all over the world take care of elephants under the supervision of local guardians.Throughout the entire week of his journey, the leader gets to know animals up close in their natural environment, gets involved in helping volunteers with their daily duties, and listens to the stories of the project's beneficiaries.These priceless experiences and proximity to wild nature cost him little money and a bit of hard work.

programs.title: Extraordinary hotels
programs.desc: The series showcases the most amazing hotels in the world.The creators will visit, among others:to Sweden and to Hollywood.Viewers will discover the most attractive places you can ever imagine.

programs.title: Man v Food 2
programs.desc: Adam sets off on a journey across the United States to take part in subsequent rounds of timed eating competitions.Adam will take on Badass Burrito in Las Vegas and a 106-centimetre pizza in San Antonio.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits Mongolia.There, in the inaccessible mountain areas of Altai, the Kazakh minority lives.They are cut off from their roots, but they maintain traditions from 3,000 years ago.The traveler meets a fourteen-year-old girl with strength and courage greater than many men.Petite, charming Akhbota practices falconry every day after school.It's hard to believe that such a delicate girl can communicate with a predatory bird weighing eight kilograms and whose wingspan reaches up to two meters.Martyna Wojciechowska tells a story about true strength, courage and the bond between man and animal.
